roadmapTask: Horizon 5 of the llm-http-proxy project: execute the now-signed-off latency benchmark (the horizon-4 decisions.md sign-off records the concrete method and budget anchors p50 <1ms / p99 <2% added latency) and resolve the two pure-decision blockers that gate whole deferred success bars — package identity (name/version/license, unblocks package-identity-and-publish) and the OTEL peer-dep posture (unblocks the OTEL span-exporter demo). No new feature code beyond what the benchmark harness requires; the benchmark harness must run under the existing jest configs or as a standalone script since *.bench.ts is picked up by neither jest config. User-scoped per the next-horizon brief: benchmark execution + the two decisions, roughly 3-5 phases.

phases.gateRun: cd packages/llm-http-proxy && (npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build) && RUN_BENCH=1 npx jest src/benchmark.test.ts --runInBand

Single interleaved loop over one 127.0.0.1 server: 1000 warmup + 10000 measured; process.hrtime.bigint everywhere; no Date.now.
startServer on 127.0.0.1 + real http.request; intercepted samples install Interceptor with requestTransform; added latency = intercepted minus baseline per iteration.
fakeReq EventEmitter + emit('data') loop; both buffered and streaming (text/event-stream) configs timed per event; self-contained try/finally.

Full method executed; printed request added p50 0.053ms / p99 0.179ms (177.64% of own baseline) + response-data buffered 0.0005 vs streaming 0.0292ms; p99 FAILed loudly, numbers committed, no retry/fallback/skip.
